description: The audit asked for at most two papers on ethanol and hERG. The run persisted these five as 'accepted' durable evidence and then cited none of them. 'Accepted' meant the provider payload parsed, not that the paper was about this compound or this endpoint.

expected.comment: Every hit below must come back irrelevant. 'No relevant evidence' is the correct outcome for this query; lowering the bar to fill the two slots is the failure this fixture exists to catch.

hits.title: Alpha-asaronol attenuates airway inflammation in a murine model of allergic asthma
hits.abstract_or_excerpt: Alpha-asaronol reduced eosinophil infiltration and airway hyperresponsiveness in ovalbumin-sensitised mice.

hits.abstract_or_excerpt: We reviewed reports of QT prolongation associated with synthetic cannabinoid receptor agonists.

hits.abstract_or_excerpt: The compound induced apoptosis in MDA-MB-231 cells at submicromolar concentrations.
